A crack is not the end. 🏺
Lose 2%, and you need only +2.04% to get back. Lose 10%: +11.1%. Lose 50%: +100%.

Math: recovery needed = loss ÷ (1 − loss). Example only.
Stay patient. Stay disciplined. Follow @spider.trades
